{{Quote|I see that our host&mdash;the guild boss himself&mdash;the infamous Groff Zugga is about to signal the start of the race.|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Beed Annodue]] introduces Guild Boss Zugga to a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] crowd|<ref name="Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>}}
The '''Galactic Spice Mining Guild''' was a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] organization fronted<ref name="Prima" /> by the [[Crime lord/Legends|kingpin]] [[Groff Zugga]], who served as a guild [[Boss/Legends|boss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]]. Under Zugga's leadership, Mon Gazza was second only to the planet [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] in spice production.<ref name="Nint">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer Official Nintendo Player's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'' Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Galactic Spice Mining Guild was created for the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''. Although it was given a fleeting mention within the home computer port of the game, the guild was not identified by name.<ref name="Racer" /> Rather, the guild's history and name were provided by the game's strategy guides.<ref name="Nint" /><ref name="Prima" />
